author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m using a SharkBite Max angle stop. I deburr the inside and outside of the pipe, then remove any loose burrs with emery cloth. I mark the appropriate depth with the depth gauge tool and push the angle stop on. This is the fastest and easiest angle stop to install for copper, PEX, or CPVC. I’ve been using them for years with no problems
title: How to Install a SharkBite Toilet Shutoff Valve - #shorts #plumbing #sponsored
